facts.meaning: Ribbons contains80 unique author IDs in file order, icon positions exactly0..79 and exactly Name/IconPosition/Description for each. Flags is omitted in all80 and constructor supplies a fresh empty Array per record; default-file suffix is empty. Names need not be unique: Hoenn and Sinnoh normal/master contest ribbons share names while their IDs/icons/descriptions remain distinct.
facts.literal_scope: Every80 ID, all240 explicit property values and original order are preserved in records and raw_text; no inferred formula replaces the literal descriptions.
facts.source_interface: Own complete Ribbon schema/constructor/message getters/flags definition, generic parser/register and compile_ribbons/writer; Name and Description feed separate message hash buckets.
facts.open: No proof that English source strings are displayed unchanged in every active language, or that icon atlas native drawing succeeds. Award/revoke/show complete domain consumers are separate; message corpus and current runtime selection do not follow merely from these literals.

facts.meaning: Ribbon record order consists of20 Hoenn contest records (five categories by four ranks),20 Sinnoh counterparts and40 special ribbons. Each literal IconPosition remains a data value rather than an award rule. Duplicate message keys can coalesce names/descriptions without coalescing distinct GameData IDs.
facts.literal_scope: All80 complete records personally read, including all40 special descriptions. Special declaration alone does not implement its description as an automatic achievement trigger.
facts.source_interface: GameData symbol identity is independent of translated name and icon position; own full Generic/Ribbon/Compiler sources establish storage and message-production interfaces.
facts.open: No invented contest/league/network mode, automatic award callback, fixed atlas dimensions or historical executable acceptance.

facts.meaning: TrainerTypes contains72 unique exact IDs and all72 specify Name/Gender/BaseMoney. Gender values parse Male0/Female1/Unknown2; five mixed roles are COOLCOUPLE/CRUSHKIN/SISANDBRO/TWINS/YOUNGCOUPLE. Fourteen specify SkillLevel; remaining58 derive skill_level from that record's base_money, not one universal skill literal. Flags omitted in all72 become empty Arrays; all IntroBGM are nil.
facts.literal_scope: All72 records/256 explicit properties and their actual case, names, gender, money and14 skill literals personally read and preserved. No same-name merging of the two trainer genders or player/rival/leader variants.
facts.source_interface: Own complete TrainerType schema/constructor/editor/resource/message getters and generic compiler/writer. Its writer omits SkillLevel when equal base_money, which is an export projection rather than loss of runtime skill.
facts.open: Complete AI use of skill and actual money settlement remain their separate finite CORE interfaces; a BaseMoney literal is not an observed payment or a host battle result.

facts.meaning: Eight leaders, four Elite Four and Champion explicitly supply BattleBGM/VictoryBGM; leaders use Battle Gym Leader, Elite Four Battle Elite, Champion Battle Champion, all13 victory fields use Battle victory leader. Other59 battle/victory fields are omitted/nil. These file strings are resource requests rather than existence, load, channel or playback success proof.
facts.literal_scope: All26 explicit audio properties are preserved with exact spaces/case and record identity; all72 omitted/present distinctions retained.
facts.source_interface: TrainerType constructor preserves nil; own complete battle-audio helper source and received CORE audio correction keep ordinary victory BGM versus capture ME distinct.
facts.open: Actual selected opponent/config/default audio fallback and asset/native playback remain separately scoped. No blanket claim this fixture determines every battle's track.

facts.meaning: Trainers has20 exact compound identities and39 ordered Pokémon members. Missing third header component normalizes to version0; Grunt M/F use1, Jeff/Susie have0 and1, Rival Blue has0/1/2, Champion Blue is a distinct trainer type. Every20 LoseText is explicit; only Brock specifies trainer Items, preserving two FULLRESTORE entries.
facts.literal_scope: All20 headers/all77 property occurrences and all39 species/level bindings personally read, with each subsequent Pokémon property bound to the correct member. No property-order deduplication or trainer-name-only identity shortcut.
facts.source_interface: Own whole dedicated trainer parser/validation and GameData::Trainer source. Duplicate trainer identity uses last registration, while this fixture has20 unique identities; unknown fields/pre-member properties retain their actual parser rules.
facts.open: All referenced Species/Move/Item literal records have not been fully received here; exact reference existence and semantic corpus remain separate from reading the complete trainer fixture. No unconditional compile success or all actual trainer battle factory acceptance.

facts.meaning: Brock's GEODUDE12 and ONIX14 alone supply explicit four moves, AbilityIndex0, male and six IV20 values. ONIX additionally supplies Rocky/SITRUSBERRY/Shinytrue/HEAVYBALL. Rocket male WEEPINBELL21 and female ELECTABUZZ20 alone explicitly Shadowtrue. Champion VENUSAUR/CHARIZARD/BLASTOISE63 each carry SITRUSBERRY. facts.literal_scope: All member fields preserved individually. Trainer.to_trainer fallback IV is min(level/2,31), fallback each-stat EV min(level*3/2,510/6); those source fallback formulas are not replaced by the fixture's two explicit IV20 vectors.
facts.source_interface: Own complete Trainer.to_trainer, all relevant parser validators and necessary Pokemon constructor/Move77 receiver methods; party append occurs before later member customization, Shadow conversion and calc_stats.
facts.open: Callbacks/Shadow full lifecycle, every referenced species/move/item record, active rival-name variable and owner-language host remain their existing named finite dependencies. Failure can preserve an already-appended/partially customized member; native factory/game execution NOT_EXECUTED.

common_premise: Fixed unmodified R/B8; these are complete author fixtures, not proof of the precompiled .dat currently loaded by an unexecuted host. Conditional compiler/factory statements assume their actual required registries/state and normal prior stages; source/parser/read evidence does not simulate the business.
